profile.summary: AFSCME Local 257 is a local union of the American Federation of State, County and Municipal Employees. It represents employees of the Oakland Unified School District and is part of AFSCME Council 57.

review.notes: The cited AFSCME Council 57 page for Local 257 shows the OUSD-focused motto, an Oakland Unified School District contract download, and the Oakland address and phone, which fits the labor tentative agreement in the agenda. The summary is neutral and supported, and contact fields are business-level only.
